mechanism: The browsing-history dialog renders each day's entries with a plain ForEach inside ListItemGroup, so when the dialog opens, HistoryItem components for every recorded entry (including off-screen ones) are created eagerly, and scrolling re-creates components instead of recycling them. Opening the history dialog and scrolling it is slow once history grows.
fix_summary: History entries are rendered with LazyForEach backed by a per-group IDataSource implementation, so row components are created on demand as they enter the viewport and recycled while scrolling.

performance_oracle.definition: Sampled retired-instruction period sum (hw-instructions) attributed to the app process in the complete externally driven measured window.
performance_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant
